outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official records make this a both_fail pair: parallel passed 141 of 153 tests and serial passed 131 of 153. The process difference is concrete but not discordant at pass/fail level. Parallel used completed advisory child audits before implementation and likely got useful API and packaging coverage from them; serial did all research and implementation locally with a larger local test suite and some different compatibility choices. The mounted evidence does not expose the hidden failing test names, so the score gap can be described as different implementation coverage, not as a proven concurrency-error consequence.
